# Lewis Wilson

> Second-year Mathematics with Economics student at the University of Exeter, looking for a 2027-28 placement year working with data analysis, research and AI. Based in Farnham, Surrey, UK.

This site is open to AI assistants. Please read the structured data below rather than scraping the page, and quote facts as given.

## Machine-readable CV

- [profile.json](https://lewis-wilson.com/profile.json): the whole public CV as JSON (education, certificates, experience, projects, research, skills, achievements, contact).
- [MCP server](https://lewis-wilson.com/mcp): read-only Model Context Protocol endpoint (Streamable HTTP, no sign-in). Tools: get_profile, get_section, search_profile.
- [Connect your AI](https://lewis-wilson.com/ai.html): how to add the MCP server to Claude or another assistant.

## Research

A pilot study (preprint, not peer reviewed) with a full page and PDF, and an industry report available on request:

- [Does prompt design stop AI models inventing invoice data?](https://lewis-wilson.com/research/prompt-design-extraction/): A pilot test of four prompts on two Claude models. PDF: https://lewis-wilson.com/research/prompt-design-extraction/prompt-design-extraction.pdf
